dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular high-contrast light perimeters forming 'O' and 'C' shapes against a dark ground. Most prominent are a large, open-ended 'C' shape on the upper-left quadrant and two distinct, closed-loop 'O' structures in the central-dorsal area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the central and lower-central regions between the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle across the upper-left to dorsal-central regions. Smaller blobs in the mid-section form a dense, irregular polygonal network.
